heading: Exclusive right to name, seals, emblems, and badges
lead: The corporation has the exclusive right to use the name “National Music Council” and seals, emblems, and badges the corporation adopts.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 15230636:676.Aug. 1, 1956, ch. 824, § 16, 70 Stat. 797. The words “sole” and “as representing such Corporation” are omitted as unnecessary.
